title: chore(console): bump pinned objectui (DatasetWidget filter/compareTo fix)
body:
Re-pin the vendored Console to objectui main (`f7a4400`), which includes **objectui#1612** — DatasetWidget now forwards the widget `filter` as the dataset `runtimeFilter` and drops the legacy string `compareTo`. This makes the merged dual-form dashboards/reports render correct filtered numbers in the console, and is the prerequisite for single-form convergence (#5).

`scripts/build-console.sh` builds clean at the new sha (`packages/console/dist` is gitignored — built from `.objectui-sha`).
